observations.behavior: Adds documentation and a Django management command to clean destination secrets.
observations.code_quote: `python manage.py clean_destination_secrets --step activity-logs` rewrites them. It is a dry run until you pass `--commit`.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds documentation and a Django management command to clean destination secrets.

observations.behavior: Adds a Django management command to remove destination credentials and input values stored in plain text.
observations.code_quote: Dry run by default. Every step skips what is already clean, so a rerun is safe.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a Django management command to remove destination credentials and input values stored in plain text.

observations.behavior: Adds a service to mask values in activity log rows written before the log masked their fields.
observations.code_quote: Masking uses `ActivityLog.safe_detail`, which keeps the field name and change action.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a service to mask values in activity log rows written before the log masked their fields.
